DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_family.do infixes DA3032 at the ES3032 DATA LIST positions (P40A01..P40A04 = cols 267-270, identical to ES3032 line 24 and to the questionnaire's column codes (267)-(270)) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 14 sets item = the variable name (p40a01..p40a04; lower-casing is Stata naming) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P40A01-P40A04 were compared with the P.40a rows of cues3032.pdf read from a 300-dpi render of scanned page 8 (not OCR); the questionnaire's hyphenated line breaks ('ali-/mentos', 'acom-/pañamiento', 'fami-/lia', 'Administra-/ción') are rejoined, and 'mis/mas' and 'administra/tivos' (line breaks whose hyphen is not visible in the scan, the preceding letter underlined) are rejoined as 'mismas' and 'administrativos', which is also the labels' spelling. 4/4 agree character for character, so item_text is the variable labels verbatim (checked in build.R with identical()). The stem's and P40A04's trailing ellipses are shipped as three ASCII periods, as the label writes them; the scan cannot distinguish that from a single ellipsis character. VALUE LABELS identical on all 4: 0 'N.P.' 1 'Habitualmente' 2 'Ocasionalmente' 3 'Nunca' 4 'No procede, no hace esas tareas' 9 'N.C.' -- matching the questionnaire's printed list 1-4 and NP/NC columns. RESP BY DESIGN: the .do recodes 0, 4 and 9 to missing, so live resp is {1,2,3} and option rows ship for those three codes only. Note that 'Nunca' means never having DIFFICULTY, not never doing the task; respondents who do not do the task answered 4 'No procede' and are absent. Dropped by the .do, per item p40a01..p40a04: code 4 = 53/466/639/29 (1187 total); code 9 = 10/12/14/10 (46 total); code 0 = 1398 on every item. FILTER: the block is headed 'SÓLO A QUIENES TIENEN TRABAJO REMUNERADO (1 en P.40)'. DA3032 confirms it exactly: every one of the 1398 code-0 records has P40 (col 266) != 1, and all 1066 records with P40 = 1 carry a code 1-4 or 9. 15 of those 1066 have no valid 1-3 code on any item, which is why live has 1051 ids; all 1051 live ids have P40 = 1. The filter header is interviewer routing, not read aloud, so it is not in instructions; it is carried in public_note. CHECKED, decisive: reading DA3032 (2464 records, all 385 bytes; id = row number) at cols 267-270, dropping 0/4/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 254 and cov_age cols 255-256 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 3031 rows both, 1051 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex stored as the Stata value label (Hombre 1591 rows, Mujer 1440, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1/2/3): p40a01 192/307/504, p40a02 121/191/276, p40a03 69/124/220, p40a04 207/403/417 -- every item uses all three levels. Coherence: 'No procede' is rarest for household tasks (53) and administrative errands (29) and commonest for child care (466) and care of dependent relatives (639), as it should be for tasks many workers never face. validate_items.R --table-sets passed (4 items, resp {1,2,3}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the P.40a stem verbatim from cues3032.pdf ('¿Podría decirme si tiene dificultad habitualmente, ocasionalmente o nunca para compaginar su trabajo con...?'), shared by all four rows, so instructions not section_prompt, one trivial section. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3032 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by this project (Habitualmente/Ocasionalmente/Nunca -> Usually/Occasionally/Never) -- issues-page line owed at upload. RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, 2026-09-22, widened to every CIS survey year 2026-09-23, irw#2381) applied, not re-derived. DESCRIPTION MISMATCH (Step 3b; logged here, not in pending_index_notes.csv, which is the orchestrator's): the right instrument and items, but the IRW dictionary Description ('How often the respondent personally does domestic tasks, child care, care of dependent relatives and administrative errands') and the .do's Bookmark 14 header comment ('frequency with which the respondent does domestic tasks ...') both misstate the construct. P.40a asks how often the respondent has DIFFICULTY reconciling their paid job with each of the four; it is asked only of people in paid work; and 'Nunca' = never has difficulty. Suggested Description: 'How often employed respondents have difficulty reconciling their paid work with household tasks, child care, care of dependent relatives and administrative errands'. The instrument field names the real question. No response-data defect: the table reproduces exactly; only the description is wrong.
public_note: Asked only of respondents in paid work; each item asks how often the respondent has difficulty combining their job with the task (not how often they do it), so 3 = never has difficulty, and 'does not do these tasks' (code 4) is coded missing; item text English is IRW machine translation of the Spanish-only CIS questionnaire
